systemic_causes: Secondary must_show filtering could remove a meaningful noun head such as reservoir and then accept contextual category text as if it proved the visible secondary object.
Singleton/adjacent machinery could lose the operating domain between consecutive mechanism scenes.
A bare machinery fallback searched only the primary object, so S5 could not retrieve a frame containing both transformer and power lines.
Maps and non-operational museum/manufacturing/transport contexts could survive topical metadata despite being wrong for a requested operating scene.
fixes: Preserve the secondary noun head and evaluate secondary compounds against separate depiction-oriented evidence.

For Wikimedia secondary must_show evidence, use title/object, short direct caption, and category segments independent of the primary subject; primary-context categories alone cannot prove the secondary visible object.
Treat maps as non-photographic Wikimedia assets.
Carry an established operating domain only across adjacent machinery scenes when the next machinery shot has no own domain; an explicit new domain overrides the inherited one.
For singleton bare-machinery fallback only, add additional visible secondary must_show objects to provider_query while preserving immutable storyboard query provenance.
Reject museum/exhibit/manufacturing/transport context only when it conflicts with a storyboard that explicitly requires operating plant/station/facility context; no blanket venue blacklist.
